title: shocked to hear the negative reviews
content: Super shocked to see negative reviews on this practice. Every time I have had a dealing with this surgery whether it be the receptionist, midwife, nurse, doctor .... it has always been super positive. The reception staff have always been super helpful and polite and fabulous if I need to get my daughter seen swiftly. The NHS is super stretched at the moment so it is important to remember this and also to be kind! everyone is doing a great job :)
real_data_note: Verbatim real patient review (4-5 star), used as a positive practice exemplar for retrieval grounding. Not an authored policy document.
